name: Redis Stale-Read Incident Pack
purpose: Investigate stale-read or cache consistency incidents involving Redis, Spring, and MySQL style persistence flows.
when_to_use: users see stale data after updates
Redis consistency is part of an operational incident
write/read races or cache repopulation behavior are under investigation
notes: Promote verification rigor if a fix recommendation is proposed.
Audit write ordering, invalidation timing, and concurrent repopulation assumptions.
Escalate to workflow.full_default if remediation sequencing is required.
